matched_cross_model_relation.division_by_zero_reason: No theorem with the same two model carriers and refinement guarantee in Clear; zero roots means empty matched slice, not a zero-cost proof.
matched_cross_model_relation.local: numeric EVM arithmetic stack with upstream operations; finite storage and capacity-bounded byte memory measured separately

bridge.proof_boundary: Lexical source closure only; external Mathlib/CSLib dependencies not counted as local development. Existing proof statements retain their premises, including bounded capacity, padding and finite-domain setup.
bridge.reason: The common arithmetic return/unchanged-state equations have one-line proofs on both sides, as measured in shared_arithmetic_state_relation. The measured Bridge relations add cross-model arithmetic-stack, finite-storage and preallocated-byte-memory refinements. Clear has no corresponding cross-model EVM-state refinement endpoint at its pinned source; its Spec relates two states of its own Yul interpreter. The sevenfold whole-project ratio counted different obligations and cannot establish redundancy.
bridge.search_boundary: All tracked Clear Lean declarations scanned and candidate headers recorded. Clear/Abstraction.Spec and Clear/State.evm_* are intramodel specifications/observational framing, not agreement with Solidity.Evm.Machine or EVMYulLean. No matched ratio fabricated.

shared_arithmetic_state_relation.conversion_scope: These extra roots compare different word representations and source instruction semantics; Clear primitive equations have no second word/machine representation. They are not added to the shared primitive ratio.
shared_arithmetic_state_relation.reason: The common primitive equations are definitional on both sides; local generic op parameter shares eight cases in one proof. Cross-model conversion and simulation add separate, explicitly measured obligations, rather than eight copies of a Clear primitive proof.
shared_arithmetic_state_relation.shared_observation: Eight arithmetic results and unchanged non-stack state. Local transformer consumes/pushes stack and increments PC; Clear returns the result list with unchanged Yul state. Observe arithmetic return plus framed non-PC state, not identical full-state functions.

bridge.verdict_boundary: Justified extra obligations in the measured relation slices; no claim that every Bridge module is necessary, or that any endpoint proves full EVM/gas/fork conformance.

bridge.reason: Justified extra obligations in the measured relation slices; no claim that every Bridge module is necessary, or that any endpoint proves full EVM/gas/fork conformance.

lowering_G_families.reason: Lexical split count is a scenario-family diagnostic, not the size of an executed proof-search tree. Inspect largest members in waste.json.

yul_views_transports.reason: Lexical split count is a scenario-family diagnostic, not the size of an executed proof-search tree. Inspect largest members in waste.json.

consolidation.unit: repeated proof scaffolding, not original theorem statements

individual_proof_effort.reason: Bodies are short relative to the measured reference distributions. Aggregate totals and theorem counts remain separate; short bodies can still multiply redundant scaffolding.

limitations: Source-level parser and lexical slices, not elaborated kernel declarations or measured human effort.
No Lean proof or external conformance test execution performed; historical timing is external evidence only.
Generated classification is provenance evidence, not historical authorship.
Case/template consolidation savings are estimates, not checked refactors.

method.distribution: Named theorem/lemma only for Lean; named Lemma/Theorem/Corollary/Remark/Fact/Proposition with explicit Proof...Qed/Defined for Coq; Theorem/Triviality...Proof...QED for HOL4. Equational definitions, examples, term-only Coq proofs and legacy HOL store_thm excluded and coverage reported.
method.provenance: Generated roots, Corpus, known vector tables, AxiomPins and explicit source markers separated. Chain/agreement names alone remain unresolved. Not-marked-generated is not a handwriting claim.
method.ratio: Mean named proof-body lines in matched subsystem populations; also p50/p90 and >100-line tails. Different theorem granularity means descriptive reference-class calibration, not labor or checking cost.
method.slice: Lexical transitive declarations constrained by imports, final identifier components overconnect; not an elaborated dependency proof. Both local-scope and all-tracked closure counted; external dependency library declarations excluded.
method.tactics: Keyword occurrences are a within-language source proxy, not executed tactic steps. Not compared numerically across tactic languages. simp brackets count comma-separated entries at outer depth, not expanded simp databases.
method.unit: Nonblank proof-body source lines after masking nested comments and strings; excludes theorem statements and Proof/Qed/Proof/QED delimiters, excludes Lean by. Inline bodies count one line.
